title: Lock screen silently drops password attempts after wake or a failed try, so retries end up wrong and trigger a faillock lockout
line: A password typed on the lock screen during the delay after a failed try or right after it wakes is now used instead of dropped, and Enter on the empty field no longer counts as a failed login.
explanation: The greeter's PamAuthenticator::respond() dropped a password that arrived while no PAM prompt was pending (during the fail delay after a wrong try, or while the worker was starting) with only a log warning, and cancel() kept the old pending prompt, so since master's 'stop authenticating while the UI is hidden' a password typed right after the lock screen reappeared went to the dead worker's prompt and vanished. In the lock screen QML, focus stayed on the unlock button until the result came back, so keys typed meanwhile were lost and Enter resent the old text; Enter on the empty field sent an empty password that PAM counts as a failed login; and the code meant to hold early passwords checked authenticator.pamTimeout, which doesn't exist. The kscreenlocker change clears the pending prompt on cancel, holds a response that arrives early and sends it to the next prompt (stored before it is announced, so it can be answered right away). The plasma-desktop change clears and refocuses the field on submit, ignores empty submits and drops the dead pamTimeout code, leaving the holding to the greeter.

commits.message:
greeter: hold a prompt response that arrives before the prompt

Responses sent during the fail delay or while the worker was starting
were dropped, and cancel() kept the old prompt so they went to a dead
worker. Clear it on cancel and hold early responses for the next prompt.

BUG: 528356

lockscreen: clear the password on submit and ignore empty ones

Keys typed while a password was checked were lost as focus sat on the
unlock button, an empty Enter counted as a failed login and pamTimeout
never existed. Clear the field on submit and skip empty passwords.

BUG: 528356

media.caption: Typed 'wrong' + Enter, then 'test' 0.7 s later: the field still holds the 5 dots of 'wrong', the new keys were lost
Same steps: the field was cleared on submit and holds the 4 dots of 'test'
5 s after pressing Enter on 'test': still locked, PAM only ever saw 'wrong'
Same steps: 'test' was held during the 2 s fail delay, sent with the next prompt, and the session unlocked
Enter twice on the empty field, then 'test' + Enter: an empty password reached PAM as a failed login, the rest was lost, still locked
Same steps: nothing reached PAM for the empty Enters and 'test' unlocked
Lock screen hidden with Escape, woken, 'test' + Enter right away: the password went to the cancelled worker's prompt, still locked
Same steps: the password was held until the new worker prompted, and the session unlocked
Recording: wrong-then-right within the fail delay, then hide/reappear and type at once; both stay locked
Same two sequences with the fix: both unlock

review.text: This is a clean, well-layered fix that addresses all the reported causes across kscreenlocker and plasma-desktop without QML timer hacks. Holding early responses in PamAuthenticator, clearing both the stale pending prompt and held response on cancel(), and storing the pending prompt before emitting prompt signals fixes the fail-delay and hide/reappear races at the right layer, while LockScreenUi.qml removes the dead pamTimeout code, clears and refocuses on submit, preserves retries on failure, and ignores empty submits. The verification with a real PAM fail-delay shim thoroughly covers all scenarios and regressions, and kscreenlocker autotests pass.
